value.strategy: Cover booking conflicts first — the highest-risk behaviour.

test_cases.title: Double booking is rejected
test_cases.given: a slot already booked with a doctor
test_cases.when: a second booking is made for the same slot
test_cases.then: the request is rejected with a conflict error
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Booking an already-taken slot is rejected with a conflict error.

coverage.note: No acceptance criteria were written for patient registration.

defects: The scaffold has no endpoint for FR-01 despite it being a must.
untestable: NFR-01 names no roles, so authorisation cannot be tested.
value.reasoning: Double booking is the highest-risk behaviour in the design, so it gets the first integration test. FR-01 has no acceptance criteria written against it, so I reported it uncovered rather than inventing an interpretation. The scaffold has no patient endpoint despite FR-01 being a must — that is a real defect, not speculation.
concerns: FR-01 has no acceptance criteria, so patient registration cannot be verified against anything.
